coordinateSystem.note: converted from Blender Z-up (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y)

pivot.method: Functional congruence fit (Nelder-Mead) of the flexion axis started from the distal-band sphere fits: minimises articular gap variation of ulnar-notch and radial-head vertices against the humerus over 0-145 deg with a penetration penalty

controller.rotationSource: node local rotation about +X (radians in glTF)

semantics.neutral_definition: Controller flexion 0 deg = true anatomical elbow extension: humerus and forearm ISB long axes collinear in the plane perpendicular to the fitted flexion axis. The source pose is NOT flexion 0.
semantics.neutral_offset_method: Signed angle about the fitted flexion axis between the ISB humerus long axis (glenohumeral centre sphere fit -> epicondyle midpoint) and the ISB forearm long axis (epicondyle midpoint -> ulnar styloid), measured on the extracted source geometry. Cross-checks: styloid midpoint 14.53 deg, radius shaft 16.93 deg, ulna shaft 25.97 deg (rejected: ulnar diaphysis is angled relative to the forearm long axis), olecranon-fossa contact sweep (0.5 mm contact at -21 deg, 2 mm at -31 deg relative to the source pose). Report: qa/reports/elbow_r.neutral_offset.json
semantics.neutral_offset_location: Applied at rig level: elbow_r__pivot orientation (+Y = forearm direction at true extension); driven children's parent-inverse matrices encode the source pose. Anatomical mesh data is unchanged.
semantics.source_pose_reference: Human_Body_Master.blend scene '01 Complete anatomy' (sha256 f7313dabbf27d990ce1d7d3f771ebf1f914ffc5fb1162a7f71339bd3e6dc7fb0). The source anatomy was supplied in a flexed pose; it is reproduced exactly at controller flexion = source_pose_flexion_deg.
semantics.range_reference_status: No external anatomical reference has been cited. A cited anatomical source for the 0-145 deg flexion range is REQUIRED before release. Current evidence is geometric only: maximum bone overlap 1.724 mm at 145 deg (coronoid process / coronoid fossa), qa/reports/elbow_r.rig_validation.final.json.

bandRepresentation.statement: A band is an educational schematic drawn between two attachment anchors. It is NOT a physically simulated or deforming ligament. Changes in endpoint distance during flexion are a visualization aid only and must not be presented as quantitative ligament strain or stretch.
bandRepresentation.ligamentMesh: The real RCL/UCL meshes are anatomical source geometry, cross-joint stationary for Milestone 1, and are never edited.
bandRepresentation.anchors: Band anchors are educational attachment representations: proximal ends are parented to elbow_r__seg_prox (fixed), distal ends to elbow_r__ctrl (move with the forearm).

motion.neutralDirection: elbow_r__overlay__axis local +Y (forearm direction at true extension)
motion.forearmDirection: elbow_r__overlay__forearm local +Y (parented to elbow_r__ctrl; rotates with flexion)
motion.motionDirection: elbow_r__overlay__forearm local +Z (tangent of the flexion arc at the current angle)

meshConvention: Each anatomy node carries extras (structureId, role, tier, side, label) and has exactly one child '<node>__mesh' with extras.meshCarrierFor = structureId holding the quantised mesh. Resolve picks by walking up to the node with extras.structureId and an anatomy role.

compression.textureNote: Textures are embedded per tier at original resolution (self-contained tiers); identical images repeat across tiers (see sharedTextures).
